target.title: fix(zalo): sanitize outbound tool traces
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Zalo outbound delivery chunks and sends assistant text without running the shared `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` delivery sanitizer used by the other #90684 channel fixes. Compact tool-trace failure lines could leak to Zalo users.

Refs #90684.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds the shared sanitizer to `zaloPlugin.outbound.sanitizeText`, matching the accepted sibling-channel pattern while keeping Zalo's existing text chunking and payload delivery flow unchanged.

## User Impact

Zalo recipients no longer see assistant internal tool-trace banners such as failed tool-call lines in outbound replies. Normal user-facing prose is preserved.

## Evidence

- Current branch head: `cd84860172`, rebased onto upstream `main` `5537bc9c4d`.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/oc-vitest-zalo-sanitize-pr2 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalo/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts extensions/zalo/src/outbound-payload.contract.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
  - 2 test files passed
  - 8 tests passed
- `~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/openclaw-pre-pr.sh --repo /root/projects/openclaw-sanitize-zalo --pr-body /root/projects/sanitizer-sweep/pr-bodies/zalo.md`
  - Passed PR context/proof policy checks and rebased cleanly.
  - Stopped before `pnpm check:changed` because the sparse worktree did not have hydrated root dependencies. Focused tests above ran with a temporary link to an already-hydrated sibling worktree; no dependency install was performed.

Not tested: live Zalo delivery.

AI-assisted change, manually reviewed and validated.
